title: Harbour and Co new starter induction (fictional company)

brief.motion: Paper and ink: printed-matter feel, hand-drawn lines that draw on, stamps that thud with a small shake, paper cards with real shadows, gentle parallax. Calm and welcoming, never slick.
brief.story: A standard HR induction deck becomes a warm welcome film. Harbour motif (waves, a lighthouse beam) ties the scenes together. Ends on a friendly sign-off.

scenes.narration: Welcome to Harbour and Co. Here's what your first week looks like.

slide.title: Welcome to Harbour & Co
slide.notes: Welcome to Harbour and Co. Here's what your first week looks like.

scenes.storyboard: paper stage with layered ink-drawn waves drifting. A lighthouse beam sweeps; on 'Welcome' the headline is printed in, and an ink underline draws itself. On 'first week' a paper calendar card slides up.

beats.text: Here's what your first week looks like.

scenes.narration: On Monday, you'll meet your team and your buddy. Midweek is tools training. On Thursday, you'll shadow a customer call, and Friday ends with a check-in with your manager.

slide.title: Your first week
slide.text: Mon: Meet your team and buddy. Tue-Wed: Systems and tools training. Thu: Shadow a customer call. Fri: Check-in with your manager
slide.notes: On Monday, you'll meet your team and your buddy. Midweek is tools training. On Thursday, you'll shadow a customer call, and Friday ends with a check-in with your manager.

scenes.storyboard: a hand-drawn route line runs left to right like a voyage chart through five day stops; a little boat travels it. Each day card pops on its spoken day with an ink icon (people, laptop, headset, coffee).

beats.text: On Monday, you'll meet your team and your buddy.
On Thursday, you'll shadow a customer call, and Friday ends with a check-in with your manager.

scenes.narration: Everything we do comes back to three values. Customers first. Own the outcome. Keep it simple.

slide.title: Our three values
slide.text: Customers first. Own the outcome. Keep it simple
slide.notes: Everything we do comes back to three values. Customers first. Own the outcome. Keep it simple.

scenes.storyboard: three big ink stamps slam down one per value on the spoken words, each with a small shake and ink splatter, numbered 1-2-3 in red.

beats.text: Everything we do comes back to three values.

scenes.narration: Stuck on anything? Your buddy is your first stop, and the people team is always one message away. Welcome aboard.

slide.title: Need help?
slide.text: Ask your buddy first. The people team is one message away. Welcome aboard
